subject: Regarding Your Recent Job Application
body: Dear [Applicant Name], Thank you for submitting your application for the Marketing Coordinator position with our company. We appreciate your interest in joining our team. We have received your application and are currently in the process of reviewing all candidates. We will be in touch with you within the next two weeks to provide an update on the status of your application. If you have any questions in the meantime, please feel free to reach out. Best regards, [Company Name]
